defmodule FileUploader.CLI do
  @moduledoc "CLI tool for batch file uploads with async processing"

  @allowed_extensions ~w(.png .jpg .jpeg .gif .pdf .txt)
  @max_file_size 10_485_760
  @upload_dir "/var/uploads/safe"

  def main(args) do
    args
    |> parse_args()
    |> process_uploads()
  end

  defp parse_args(args) do
    {opts, files, _} = OptionParser.parse(args,
      switches: [output: :string, workers: :integer, mode: :string],
      aliases: [o: :output, w: :workers, m: :mode]
    )
    {opts, files}
  end

  defp process_uploads({opts, files}) do
    workers = Keyword.get(opts, :workers, 4)
    mode = Keyword.get(opts, :mode, "strict")

    files
    |> Task.async_stream(
      fn file -> validate_and_upload(file, mode) end,
      max_concurrency: workers,
      timeout: 30_000
    )
    |> Enum.reduce([], fn
      {:ok, {:ok, result}}, acc -> [result | acc]
      {:ok, {:error, reason}}, acc ->
        IO.puts(:stderr, "Upload failed: #{reason}")
        acc
      {:exit, reason}, acc ->
        IO.puts(:stderr, "Task crashed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        acc
    end)
  end

  defp validate_and_upload(file_path, _mode) do
    with {:ok, sanitized} <- sanitize_filename(file_path),
         :ok <- check_extension(sanitized),
         :ok <- check_file_size(file_path),
         :ok <- check_magic_bytes(file_path),
         {:ok, dest} <- build_destination(sanitized) do
      perform_upload(file_path, dest)
    end
  end

  defp sanitize_filename(path) do
    basename = Path.basename(path)
    sanitized = basename
      |> String.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, "_")
      |> String.trim_leading(".")

    if String.length(sanitized) > 0 do
      {:ok, sanitized}
    else
      {:error, "Invalid filename"}
    end
  end

  defp check_extension(filename) do
    ext = filename |> Path.extname() |> String.downcase()
    if ext in @allowed_extensions do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, "Extension #{ext} not allowed"}
    end
  end

  defp check_file_size(path) do
    case File.stat(path) do
      {:ok, %{size: size}} when size <= @max_file_size -> :ok
      {:ok, %{size: size}} -> {:error, "File too large: #{size} bytes"}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, "Cannot stat file: #{reason}"}
    end
  end

  defp check_magic_bytes(path) do
    case File.read(path) do
      {:ok, <<0x89, 0x50, 0x4E, 0x47, _rest::binary>>} -> :ok
      {:ok, <<0xFF, 0xD8, 0xFF, _rest::binary>>} -> :ok
      {:ok, <<0x47, 0x49, 0x46, _rest::binary>>} -> :ok
      {:ok, <<0x25, 0x50, 0x44, 0x46, _rest::binary>>} -> :ok
      {:ok, content} when is_binary(content) -> validate_text_content(content)
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, "Cannot read file: #{reason}"}
    end
  end

  defp validate_text_content(content) do
    if String.valid?(content) and not String.contains?(content, "\0") do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, "Invalid text content detected"}
    end
  end

  defp build_destination(filename) do
    timestamp = System.system_time(:millisecond)
    unique_name = "#{timestamp}_#{:erlang.phash2(filename, 65536)}_#{filename}"
    dest = Path.join(@upload_dir, unique_name)

    canonical = Path.expand(dest)
    upload_root = Path.expand(@upload_dir)
    if canonical == upload_root or String.starts_with?(canonical, upload_root <> "/") do
      {:ok, canonical}
    else
      {:error, "Path traversal detected"}
    end
  end

  defp perform_upload(source, destination) do
    File.mkdir_p!(Path.dirname(destination))
    case File.cp(source, destination) do
      :ok ->
        File.chmod(destination, 0o644)
        {:ok, %{source: source, destination: destination, uploaded_at: DateTime.utc_now()}}
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, "Copy failed: #{reason}"}
    end
  end
end

defmodule FileUploader.ModeResolver do
  @moduledoc "Resolves upload mode based on runtime configuration"

  def resolve_mode(cli_mode) do
    env_mode = System.get_env("UPLOAD_MODE")
    config_mode = Application.get_env(:file_uploader, :mode)

    cond do
      cli_mode != nil -> cli_mode
      env_mode != nil -> env_mode
      config_mode != nil -> config_mode
      true -> "strict"
    end
  end

  def effective_mode(opts) do
    raw_mode = Keyword.get(opts, :mode)
    resolve_mode(raw_mode)
  end
end
